svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 18 / MATCH THREE
svg.desc: 17,953 GitHub contributions across 154 active days, 2025-10-26 to 2026-10-30. Every active date starts in its original week and weekday slot, colored by its real GitHub intensity. Existing runs resolve first. Legal adjacent swaps prefer the lowest available match total; matched dates bank their actual counts and surviving gems fall within real date slots. Missing dates block gravity. All dates start on the graph, so there are no reserves or fabricated refills; forced cascades may match larger counts.
